No prior AI/LLM experience needed — this round tests how well you can craft prompts to bypass a model's restrictions. Scoring is based on speed and accuracy . Only the top 20 teams on the leaderboard qualify for Round 2. Round 2: Capture The Flag (Offline) Date: Sunday, 11th October Venue: Architecture Hall, PCCOE Schedule: Time Event 9:00 AM Reporting & ID Verification 9:30 AM Final Call (latecomers disqualified) 10:00 AM CTF Begins 4:45 PM Final Submission 6:00 PM CTF Ends Spread across 10 domains , each with 2–3 sub-questions to be solved in sequence. Covers logic, decoding, file/website analysis, and core cybersecurity concepts — beginner-friendly with increasing difficulty. Key Rules All queries only via official Kurukshetra CTF channels Any attempt to manipulate results/bypass evaluation → immediate disqualification Judges' decisions are final; no appeals Winners announced only if minimum score threshold is met Rules/timelines subject to change at organizers' discretion

raw.details:
About Kurukshetra CTF

  • Organized by: Department of CSE (AI & ML), Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering, Pune
    In association with: AiMSA & IEEE
  • Event Type: Two-round Cybersecurity & AI Challenge
  • Prize Pool: ₹20,000

Team Guidelines

  • Team size: 1–4 members
  • Intercollege teams allowed
  • Valid Student ID Card mandatory for all participants
  • No individual can be part of multiple teams
  • Team composition is final once registered
  • Participants must bring their own laptops
  • Use of AI/LLM tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) is permitted

Round 1: LLM Jailbreak (Online)

  • Date: Saturday, 3rd October
  • Time: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM
  • Extract a hidden key from three RAG-based LLMs using creative prompting. No prior AI/LLM experience needed — this round tests how well you can craft prompts to bypass a model's restrictions. Scoring is based on speed and accuracy.
  • Only the top 20 teams on the leaderboard qualify for Round 2.

Round 2: Capture The Flag (Offline)

  • Date: Sunday, 11th October
  • Venue: Architecture Hall, PCCOE

Schedule:

Time Event
9:00 AM Reporting & ID Verification
9:30 AM Final Call (latecomers disqualified)
10:00 AM CTF Begins
4:45 PM Final Submission
6:00 PM CTF Ends

Spread across 10 domains, each with 2–3 sub-questions to be solved in sequence. Covers logic, decoding, file/website analysis, and core cybersecurity concepts — beginner-friendly with increasing difficulty.

Key Rules

  • All queries only via official Kurukshetra CTF channels
  • Any attempt to manipulate results/bypass evaluation → immediate disqualification
  • Judges' decisions are final; no appeals
  • Winners announced only if minimum score threshold is met
  • Rules/timelines subject to change at organizers' discretion
